Title: Serverless Framework plugin for Azure API Management and Azure Functions is now available

Body.Content:
Serverless Framework is a popular multi-cloud solution for building and operating serverless applications.

The new open-source serverless Azure Functions plugin extends the benefits of Serverless Framework to Azure services. It allows you to create, configure, manage, and deploy serverless applications built with Azure Functions and Azure API Management.

Browse examples in the GitHub repository and follow the “readme” instructions to get started.

Learn more about the benefits of using API Management with microservices.
